additions.description: Implements 'favorited' and 'favoritesCount' fields in article responses
additions.reasoning: The specification does not mention any favoriting functionality, but the code includes these fields in article responses with default values.
The specification does not mention any endpoint for deleting users by email, but the code implements this functionality.
The specification does not mention any endpoint for listing all tags, but the code implements this functionality.

omissions.description: Does not return empty object {} for deleted articles as specified
omissions.reasoning: The specification states that GET /api/articles/{slug} should return 200 with empty object {} for deleted articles, but the code returns 404.

omissions.description: Does not prevent non-owners from updating/deleting articles as specified
omissions.reasoning: The specification demonstrates that any user should be able to update/delete any article, but the code implements owner-only restrictions.

omissions.description: Does not return 500 when attempting to delete a user with articles
omissions.reasoning: The specification states that deleting a user with articles should return 500 (FK constraint error), but the code returns 200.

omissions.description: Does not validate that comment IDs are numbers as specified
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires comment IDs to be numbers, but the code uses database-generated integer IDs without explicit validation.

omissions.description: Does not implement POST /users/login endpoint as specified
omissions.reasoning: The specification mentions POST /users/login but the code implements POST /api/users/login instead.

omissions.description: Does not return 400 when attempting to follow oneself
omissions.reasoning: The specification states that attempting to follow oneself should return 400, but the code silently ignores such requests.
